info.screen.roleid.green:
Civilian
Alice... where are you..

Skill - Return Everyone to Rooms: usable while your SAN is above 70, once per round for the whole lobby.
Teleports every player back to their own room and makes every role whose SAN can be reduced lose 50 SAN.

While your SAN is below 30, a bare-handed left click knocks the target back but never deals any damage.

You spawn with a book and quill; it is dropped on the ground when you die.

Shop: Mania (150 coins) - instantly sets your own SAN to 0.

info.screen.roleid.better_gangster:
New shop items:
- Claymore Mine (50g):
Buy it for 50g. Hold right-click for 0.5s to drop it at your feet; after 1s you may right-click to arm it. An armed claymore is shown to killers / killer-neutrals as a red outline through walls. It detonates when a player stands within 0.8 blocks directly in front of it, killing everyone in a 2-block, 70-degree fan in front of it.
Anyone within 1 block can sneak + right-click the claymore for 5s to defuse it. When defused, the owner is notified and refunded 50g. Each Better Gangster may have at most one claymore deployed.

- Anti-Personnel Mine (80g):
Buy it for 80g. Hold right-click for 1s to drop it at your feet; it arms itself 1s after the owner leaves the planting spot. An armed anti-personnel mine is shown to killers / killer-neutrals as a red outline through walls. When someone steps on it a pressure-plate click plays and it does NOT explode; it detonates the moment that player steps off. Dropping an item on top of it prevents detonation. It can be defused with pliers from within 2.5 blocks; if defused, the owner is notified and refunded 50g. Each Better Gangster may have at most two anti-personnel mines deployed.

- Bring Chaos (400g)
Buying it puts you into a psycho mode similar to the Magician's: you can switch items and receive a loaded RPG-7. The RPG-7 blast radius equals the C4's. Knife kills during the mode grant one extra RPG-7 rocket. When the mode ends the RPG-7 and all rockets are taken back. (RPG-7: left-click to reload, right-click to fire.)

Remote Detonation skill:
Every mine supports remote detonation. Aim at the mine to detonate it. Within 50 blocks the detonation is instant; beyond 50 blocks it has a 1s fuse. Maximum range is 200 blocks; targets beyond that cannot be detonated. While the fuse burns, if any player within 3 blocks of the mine carries pliers, remote detonation is blocked.
